title: 开始

content_zh:
“米儿！”一声长唤悠悠荡荡的传来，“米儿！该回了！”
米儿，也就是林渊，拍拍自己屁股后的草梗子站起来，叉腰应了一声：“哦！”
这操蛋的世界！！
林渊自认人生还算普通平凡，就算死也死得没有一点新意：车祸。现在车越来越多，哪个路口没有死过人？她又是三更半夜出现在空无一人的郊区马路口，被飞车撞飞真是太正常了。
去TMD！
好汉不提当年勇，不管她死之前是什么样，死后万事成空。她也挺想得开的，眼一闭再一睁，就变成了个小娃娃了。
娃娃是真小，站都站不直那种，一站就头重脚轻往下栽，幸好床跟地齐沿儿——厚草铺的床，没一头栽死她。等她醒过神就发现，这是个大家庭！床上除了她还有个只会吃奶的小娃娃，床下有三个姐姐两个哥哥，除了他们之外这家没大人。
两天后她才发现那个面相最嫩的“姐姐”不是姐姐，而是妈。
林渊吃了好大一个惊！“妈”看起来最多十三！她是怎么生下六个孩子的？！剩下那两个哥不会有一个是爹吧？就算一个是爹，另一个不会是爹的爹吧？
除了家里的亲缘关系成迷之外，这个家最大的问题是穷。林渊也发现自己站不直不是还小，而是饿得，饿得小，她摸了自己的牙，乳牙都齐了，怎么也不会太小了，可她扶着哥哥的腿站直了硬是够不到他的腰！伸直胳膊都摸不到！难道他的腿有一米五长吗？！一米二就可以买票了！她见过邻居的孩子！四岁就一米二了！
听说有卖奶狗的黑心商家不给狗喂饱来让狗看起来没满月，她这样也不知是饿了多久，“家”里怎么着一天也有一顿饭吃啊。
等到草开始发黄，连这顿汤也没了之后，她才知道那一天一顿能捞半碗不知是什么粮食的汤也是她才有的优待，剩下的包括还在喂奶的“妈”在内和姐姐和哥哥都只能喝稀汤，还只有半碗。
现在全家一起饿肚子了。
林渊也想发挥一下穿越的优势，她也能说两句话了，两个月也够她说一些简单的句子了，缠着哥哥抱她出门看有没有什么办法可想。但哥哥抱着她爬了两座山头也没看到第二户人家后，她领悟到了为什么书上说到了明朝才有资本阶级萌芽。商业行为，首先需要足够多的潜在客户，其次需要足够多的剩余产品。她就算能在这地方借主角模板变出一些商品，卖给谁去？！
天越来越冷后，家里连每天一顿的饭都没了，两个哥哥天天四处挖地洞——挖野老鼠，不只是为了吃肉，过冬的老鼠洞里藏的吃的东西多！要是能碰到抱窝的老鼠那就是一顿大餐！三吱什么的，果然是传承百年的美食！搞得林渊现在一看到老鼠就眼放贼光！
两个姐姐也没闲着，天天挖草。草根是可以吃的，这附近几座山就他们一家，等于他们家承包了这附近所有的草！所以林渊看到尤带绿意的草也两眼放光，这种还绿的草根好吃，已经发黄的就不好吃了。
小弟弟被迫断了奶，瘦得像骷髅娃娃，林渊怕他活不下去，早早的开始把草根野老鼠捣成泥塞他，正常孩子这么搞肯定早进医院拉肚子去了，但这孩子命硬，竟然也这样活下来了。
等连草全都变黄了，这附近的老鼠也快掏光了，他们眼见只能吃土了，“妈”要去走亲戚了。
林渊以为是“妈”是去娘家借粮，还想缠着过去卖卖萌多借点，被哥哥抱住了，两个姐姐对她说等明年她们也能去了，家里就有更多吃的了。
林渊上辈子好歹也是个老司机，顿时反应过来！立刻号啕大哭把“妈”留下了，她号了四天，睡觉都记得抱住“妈”的腿，结果早上醒来才发现换人了，“妈”趁她夜里睡熟还是走了。

冷静下来后，林渊理智的思考了一下，离家出走了。没了她，家里就少了一张口，能多省下些粮食。反正她这辈子就是捡来的，而这人生看起来也实在没什么好留恋的，早死早脱生吧。她本来还想把小弟弟也抱走，临下手时实在动不了手就没抱出来。
那夜，趁着没月亮，她跑了，走了一夜一天，等天开始发黄时，大哥出现了，轻轻松松把她抱起来顶在肩上说：“累了吧？回家吧。”然后教训她，“我知道你想去找娘，可你连路都没认对，下回别乱跑了。”

content_en:
"Mi'er!" A long call came, "Mi'er! It's time to go back!"
Mi'er, also known as Lin Yuan, stood up after patting his buttocks, put his hands on his hips and said, "Oh!"
This fucking world! !
Lin Yuan believed that his life was quite ordinary, and even if he died, he would die without anything new: a car accident. Nowadays, there are more and more cars. Which intersection has no one died at? She appeared at a deserted suburban intersection in the middle of the night, and it was completely normal for her to be hit by a speeding car.
Go to hell!
A hero does not mention his former bravery, no matter what he was like before his death, everything will be in vain after his death. She is also quite open-minded. When she closes her eyes and opens them again, she turns into a little doll.
The baby was so small that she couldn't even stand straight. She would fall top-heavy as soon as she stood. Fortunately, the bed was flush with the floor - it was a bed made of thick straw, so she didn't fall to her death. When she woke up, she realized that this was a big family! Besides her, there was a little baby on the bed who could only suck milk. There were three sisters and two brothers under the bed. Apart from them, there were no adults in the family.
Two days later she discovered that the "sister" with the tenderest face was not her sister, but her mother.
Lin Yuan was shocked! "Mom" looks like she is thirteen at most! How did she give birth to six children? ! Will one of the remaining two brothers be the father? Even if one is the father, the other cannot be the father's father, right?
In addition to the mystery of family relationships, the biggest problem in this family is poverty. Lin Yuan also found that she couldn't stand up straight not because she was too young, but because she was so hungry. She touched her teeth and found that all her deciduous teeth were all present, so she couldn't be too small. However, she held her brother's legs and stood up straight, but she couldn't reach his waist! I can't even touch it with my arms stretched out! Are his legs one and a half meters long? ! You can buy a ticket for only 1.2 meters! She's seen the neighbor's kids! He is 1.2 meters tall at the age of four!
I heard that some unscrupulous businessmen who sell milk dogs don’t feed the dogs to make them look less than a month old. I don’t know how long she has been hungry like this. How come she has one meal a day in her “home”.
When the grass started to turn yellow and even the soup was gone, she realized that it was only her privilege to get half a bowl of soup made from unknown grains that day. The rest, including "Mom" who was still breastfeeding, her sister and brother could only drink half a bowl of thin soup.
Now the whole family is hungry together.
Lin Yuan also wanted to take advantage of time travel. She could also speak a few sentences. Two months was enough for her to speak some simple sentences. She pestered her brother to carry her out and see if there was anything she could do. But after her brother carried her up two hills without seeing a second home, she realized why the book said that the capitalist class did not sprout until the Ming Dynasty. Business activities first require enough potential customers, and secondly enough remaining products. Even if she could borrow the protagonist's template here to create some products, who would she sell them to? !
As the weather got colder and colder, the family didn't even have one meal a day. The two brothers dug holes in the ground every day - digging wild mice, not only for eating meat, but there was a lot of food hidden in the mouse holes during the winter! If you can meet a nesting mouse, it will be a big meal! Sanzhi and so on, it is indeed a delicacy that has been passed down for hundreds of years! As a result, Lin Yuan's eyes light up whenever he sees a mouse!
The two sisters are not idle either, digging grass every day. Grass roots are edible, and they are the only ones in the nearby mountains, which means that their family owns all the grass nearby! So Lin Yuan's eyes lit up when he saw the green grass. The roots of this kind of grass that are still green are delicious, but the ones that have turned yellow are not.
The little brother had to be weaned from the breast and was as thin as a skeleton doll. Lin Yuan was afraid that he would not survive, so he started to pound wild mice into mud early and stuff them into him. A normal child would have gone to the hospital and suffered from diarrhea long ago, but this child had a hard life and survived like this.
When all the grass turned yellow and the rats in the area were almost gone, they could only eat dirt, and "Mom" was going to visit relatives.
Lin Yuan thoughtIt was "Mom" who was going to her parents' house to borrow food. She wanted to be cute and borrow more food, but her brother hugged her. Her two sisters told her that when they could go there next year, they would have more food at home.
Lin Yuan was also an experienced driver in his previous life, so he immediately realized what he was doing! She immediately cried loudly and left "Mom" behind. She kept calling her for four days and remembered to hug "Mom"'s legs when she went to sleep. However, when she woke up in the morning, she found that she had been replaced and "Mom" left while she was asleep at night.
After calming down, Lin Yuan thought rationally and ran away from home. Without her, there is one less mouth in the family and more food can be saved. Anyway, she picked it up in this life, and it seems that there is really nothing to miss in this life. She should die early and escape life. She originally wanted to take her little brother away, but she couldn't move her hands so she didn't take him out.
That night, when there was no moon, she ran away and walked all night and day. When the sky started to turn yellow, her elder brother appeared, easily picked her up and put her on his shoulders and said, "Are you tired? Go home." Then he taught her a lesson, "I know you want to find your mother, but you don't even know the right way. Don't run around next time."
